title: 고요한 슬픔
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop track with elements of funk and bubblegum pop. The arrangement features a syncopated slap bass line, clean electric guitar scratches on the off-beats, and a bright acoustic piano playing rhythmic chords. The percussion consists of a crisp snare, a tight kick drum, and occasional tambourine hits. Male vocals alternate between melodic singing and rhythmic rap delivery, with female backing vocals providing harmonies during the chorus. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of G Major. Synthesizer accents include bright brass stabs and subtle digital pads.
